body:
Slice 4 of #4277. The "primary surface" half — sequence last, after sync lands.

## Why

The presence of a GitHub token still decides which store is primary, in the wrong direction.

**Triage.** `store/slices/projects.ts:317` -> `constants.ts:52`: `local = !s.githubToken`. Connected, the triage agent runs `gh issue list`; disconnected, it runs `bsc plan`. The local path is the fallback, so the moment a token exists we hand the agent GitHub's copy instead of ours.

**The board screens.** Issues / ProjectBoard / Insights / Roadmap all fetch through `useActiveProjectGithub` (`Issues.tsx:49`, `ProjectBoard.tsx:39`, `Insights.tsx:77`). Disconnected, all four render empty while plan.db holds every issue.

**Publish.** `usePlanPublish.ts:289` — `if (!githubToken) { await commitLocal(); return; }`. The connected path does call `materializeIssues` first, so plan.db is written either way, but the control flow reads as "GitHub is the real thing".

## Scope

- Triage fetches from `bsc plan` in **both** cases; `gh` becomes enrichment, not the source. The #738 restrict-to-bsc guard still governs anything pulled from GitHub.
- The four board screens read plan.db first and overlay GitHub state where present — the union shape `fleetPlanProgress.ts` / `unionDone` already uses, where neither source is authoritative alone.
- `handlePublish` always materializes locally first, then pushes if connected.

## Acceptance

- [ ] With a token connected and the network unplugged, the board screens still render every issue.
- [ ] The triage prompt names `bsc plan` as the fetch regardless of token state.
- [ ] No behaviour regression for a connected project that is fully synced — the overlay reports the same states it does today.
- [ ] `local-first-github-overlay` (#2444) holds: render local-first, never token-gate.

milestone.description: Accessibility for visually impaired users: screen-reader/keyboard semantic baseline + app-owned TTS for the structured coordination stream.

title: Read plan.db first: the board screens and triage stop depending on a token
